meta.name: PC
meta.description: PC — migrated verbatim from tools/material_db.json (typical desktop-FDM datasheet-class values) plus the heat-set pull-out table from joint_check.py. Poisson is a typical thermoplastic value (absent from material_db). Thermal-transport fields are null: not present in the migrated source, not invented.

sn_curve.note: engineering rule of thumb (~1e6-cycle allowable = ultimate x knockdown), NOT a measured S-N curve

anisotropy.model: scalar-tier direction heuristic (production_check.py): across-layer (Z) tensile strength / in-plane (XY) strength; applied when the primary load is > threshold deg out of the layer plane

heatset_pullout_n.note: brass knurled heat-set at standard insert length; conservative low ends (joint_check.py)

sources.mechanical.poisson: typical thermoplastic (material_db.json has no poisson); provided for FEA
sources._db_source_note: typical printed-PC datasheets (Prusament PC Blend tensile ~63 MPa, HDT-B ~113 C); strong but notoriously poor layer adhesion without a hot chamber — 0.45.
sources.thermal.conductivity_w_mk: 0.20 W/mK @23 C: generic PC 0.19-0.22 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polycarbonate and Professional Plastics chart https://www.professionalplastics.com/professionalplastics/ThermalPropertiesofPlasticMaterials.pdf (possibly shared handbook ancestry); independent lineage Kruse 0.19-0.25 https://krusetraining.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/12/List-Of-Materials-Specific-Heat-Capacity-Ranges.pdf ; material-properties.org 0.2 https://material-properties.org/polycarbonate-density-strength-melting-point-thermal-conductivity/
sources.thermal.specific_heat_j_kgk: 1200 J/kgK @RT: generic PC 1.2-1.3 kJ/kgK https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polycarbonate ; DSC of PC/ABS 1181-1206 J/kgK @25 C https://www.researchgate.net/publication/318354603
sources.thermal.tg_or_melt_c: Tg 113 C = LOW end of the FDM-PC brand spread (never average): Polymaker PolyLite PC (a PC BLEND, like most desktop PC) Tg 113 C DSC https://wiki.polymaker.com/polymaker-products/more-about-our-products/documents/technical-data-sheets/polycarbonate/polylite-tm-pc ; Bambu PC Tg 145 C https://wiki.bambulab.com/filament-acc/abs-asa-pc/a52afdccddfd448583d119587122c8c5.pdf ; pure molded PC 147 C https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polycarbonate — desktop 'PC' is usually NOT pure PC
sources.thermal.softening_c: softening_c = conservative softening allowable for sustained-load design: the LOW end of min(Tg, HDT-B 0.45 MPa) across cited brand TDS values for this material class (degC). PC: 111 C = Polymaker PolyLite PC HDT 0.45 MPa ISO 75 (URL above); Bambu PC HDT 0.45 = 112 C — the two FDM blends agree; molded pure PC (140 C) does NOT describe printed stock
sources.thermal._printed_anisotropy_note: printed parts conduct WORSE than bulk, direction-dependent: inter-layer thermal contact resistance dominates through-thickness conduction (Prajapati et al., Additive Manufacturing 2018, https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S2214860417305456); voids/porosity measurably reduce heat transmission even at 100% infill (Entropy 24:654 2022, https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9141791/); through-plane k reported ~20-40% below in-plane in FDM literature (secondary synthesis, primaries paywalled — treat percentage as indicative). Records store the conservative-LOW isotropic value.
sources.thermal._cp_temperature_note: cp is strongly temperature-dependent (amorphous polymers jump +30-50% crossing Tg; Covestro shows TPU cp +~15% from 20C to 80C) — record values are ROOM-TEMPERATURE-class unless noted
